# Itqan Invest — إتقان للاستثمار

> English: Itqan Invest is the foreign-investor website of Itqan Business Services (Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, founded 2024). It explains and delivers investment registration (commonly called the "MISA license"), company incorporation with 100% foreign ownership, acquisition of a qualified foreign company, and post-setup support. The site is available in English and Arabic.
> العربية: إتقان للاستثمار هو موقع المستثمر الأجنبي التابع لإتقان لخدمات الأعمال (الرياض، تأسست 2024). يشرح ويقدّم التسجيل الاستثماري (رخصة MISA)، وتأسيس الشركات بملكية أجنبية 100%، والاستحواذ على شركة أجنبية مؤهلة، والدعم بعد التأسيس، والموقع متاح بالعربية والإنجليزية.

## Key facts
- Since the updated Investment Law took effect in February 2025, the official procedure is called "investment registration"; many people still say "MISA license".
- Most sectors allow 100% foreign ownership with no mandatory local partner (some activities are restricted or excluded).
- Investment registration typically takes 5–15 working days when documents are complete; incorporation and commercial registration follow.
- Requirements and fees are set by the Ministry of Investment and change; always verify current figures.
- Execution platform (login, readiness assessment, quotes, e-signature, tracking): https://start.itqanbs.sa/
- Parent company website: https://www.itqanbs.sa/
